The final step links this helicase to the Inner centromere protein, suggesting a possible regulatory or functional relationship. The integration of these interactions implies that Levodopa could influence the activity of the Werner syndrome helicase, which in turn may affect the Inner centromere protein. This chain of interactions highlights a possible role for Levodopa in modulating centromere function, though the exact mechanism remains to be elucidated.
